summary: Iteration 14 verified. Fix confirmed: WhatsApp CTA button now renders UNCONDITIONALLY on every OfferCard regardless of redeem_location. Tested on: (1) Bosch KGN56LB42I PDP — the sole existing no_cost_emi/online offer now shows a green 'Contact Us on WhatsApp to Redeem' button (bg-emerald-600) with MessageCircle icon, data-testid=offer-whatsapp-<uuid>, target=_blank, href starts with https://wa.me/919844577440?text=. (2) /checkout page after adding Bosch KGN56LB42I to cart — the OffersDisplay renders in the right column below the payment method with the same green WhatsApp CTA and correct wa.me deep link. (3) Created 8 test offers (one per offer_type: no_cost_emi, bank_offer, cashback, upi_offer, exchange_offer, extended_warranty, seasonal_offer, partner_offer) all with redeem_location='online' via POST /api/offers/admin/create. Reloaded PDP: 9 offer cards rendered (8 test + 1 existing), ALL 9 cards showed the WhatsApp CTA button — 100% coverage across every offer_type even when redeem_location=online. Backend regression: /api/offers/product/{id} still populates whatsapp_message on every serialized offer (0/9 missing). Footer helper text updated on OffersDisplay: 'To redeem any offer, tap Contact Us on WhatsApp to reach our offline store team.' All 8 test offers deleted; total offers back to 442.
critical_code_review_comments: OffersDisplay.js OfferCard now renders WhatsApp CTA unconditionally (line 55-65). Import switched from ExternalLink to MessageCircle. Fallback href='#' when whatsapp_message is missing is defensive but backend always populates it via _serialize_public, so href='#' should never occur in practice.
The button uses target='_blank' with rel='noopener noreferrer' — good.
Note (carried from iter 13): OfferUpdate model still does not whitelist offer_type on PUT — any string could be persisted via update. Consider adding whitelist validation.
Note: POST /api/offers/admin/create is not auth-gated (any client can create/delete offers). Consider adding an admin auth dependency.
